faqs.question: What is your typical turnaround time for video editing?
faqs.answer: For short-form content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts), standard delivery is 24 to 48 hours. Long-form YouTube edits or motion graphic commercials typically take 3 to 5 business days depending on footage length and complexity.

faqs.question: How do revisions work if I need changes?
faqs.answer: Your satisfaction is my priority. Every project includes revisions to make sure the cuts, pacing, graphics, color grading, and audio match your exact vision.

faqs.question: What budget do I need to start Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads?
faqs.answer: You can start testing with an ad spend as low as $10 - $20 per day. I set up proper A/B split tests to identify winning creatives before scaling your budget to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).

faqs.question: Can I hire you for on-demand or monthly retainers?
faqs.answer: Yes! I work on both single on-demand projects and monthly retainer packages for creators and businesses requiring ongoing video editing, graphic design, or ad campaign management.
